mapper.select:
SELECT v.*, t.name as assetName,t.show_core as showCore,t.A_B_FLAG as aBFlag, t.id as assetId, t.org_id as assetOrgId, t.asset_mode as assetMode,t.watch FROM asset t left join TOPO_VERTEX v on t.id = v.asset_id and t.org_id=v.org_id and v.node_type =#{nodeType} where t.ORG_ID = #{orgId} and t.SHOW_TOPO=1 and t.ASSET_MODE in
#{mode}
and IS_DEL=1
and REGEXP_INSTR(t.name, #{name})>0
order by CASE WHEN v.name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, v.name

SELECT v.*,t.show_core as showCore, t.name as assetName,t.A_B_FLAG as aBFlag, t.id as assetId, t.org_id as assetOrgId, t.asset_mode as assetMode,t.watch FROM asset t left join TOPO_VERTEX v on t.id = v.asset_id and t.org_id=v.org_id and v.node_type =#{nodeType} where t.ORG_ID = #{orgId} and t.SHOW_TOPO=1 and t.ASSET_MODE in
#{mode}
and IS_DEL=1
and REGEXP_INSTR(t.name, #{name})>0
order by CASE WHEN v.name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, v.name

SELECT v.*, t.name as assetName, t.id as assetId, t.org_id as assetOrgId, t.asset_mode as assetMode,t.watch, '0' alarmLevel, f.view_url FROM asset t left join FILE_RELATE f on f.ITEM_ID = t.id left join TOPO_VERTEX v on t.id = v.asset_id and t.org_id=v.org_id and v.node_type =#{nodeType} where t.ORG_ID = #{orgId} and t.ASSET_MODE = #{mode1} and t.DESK=1831 and IS_DEL=1
and REGEXP_INSTR(t.name, #{name})>0
order by CASE WHEN v.name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, v.name

SELECT v.*, t.name as assetName, t.id as assetId, t.org_id as assetOrgId, t.asset_mode as assetMode, t.watch FROM asset t left join TOPO_VERTEX v on t.id = v.asset_id and v.node_type = 'netWorkAsset_topo' and v.core_asset_id = #{assetId} where t.id in (select at_asset_id from COLLECT_ROUTE where asset_id = #{assetId} and at_asset_id is not null) or t.id = #{assetId} order by is_port desc

SELECT alarm.alarmLevel, v.*,
r.status as clusterStatus, r.SERVER_ROLE as serverRole, r.SERVER_IP as serverIp, r.SERVER_IP2 as serverIp2,
t.name as assetName, t.A_B_FLAG, t.id as assetId, t.org_id as assetOrgId, t.asset_image as assetImage, t.show_core as showCore, t.asset_mode as assetMode, t.watch FROM asset t left join TOPO_VERTEX v on t.id = v.asset_id and t.org_id = v.org_id and v.NODE_TYPE = #{nodeType} left join COLLECT_CLUSTER r on t.id = r.ASSET_ID and v.NAME = r.SERVER_NAME left join (SELECT a.ID, MIN(i.ALARM_LEVEL) alarmLevel FROM ALARM_INFO i LEFT JOIN ASSET a ON i.ASSET_ID = a.ID WHERE a.ASSET_MODE IN (42, 201) AND a.ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND (i.STATUS = 1 OR (i.STATUS = 2 AND i.ALARM_STATE = 1)) and i.BLANK = 1 GROUP BY a.ID) alarm on t.id = alarm.id
where t.ORG_ID = #{orgId} and t.SHOW_TOPO = 1 and (t.ASSET_MODE = #{mode1} or t.ASSET_MODE = #{mode2}) and IS_DEL = 1 order by CASE WHEN v.name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, v.name

SELECT alarm.alarmLevel, v.*, r.status as clusterStatus, r.SERVER_ROLE as serverRole, r.SERVER_IP as serverIp, r.SERVER_IP2 as serverIp2,
t.name as assetName, t.id as assetId, t.org_id as assetOrgId, t.asset_image as assetImage, t.show_core as showCore, t.watch, t.A_B_FLAG, t.asset_mode as assetMode FROM asset t left join TOPO_VERTEX v on t.id = v.asset_id and t.org_id = v.org_id and v.NODE_TYPE = #{nodeType} left join COLLECT_CLUSTER r on t.id = r.ASSET_ID and v.NAME = r.SERVER_NAME left join (SELECT a.ID, MIN(i.ALARM_LEVEL) alarmLevel FROM ALARM_INFO i LEFT JOIN ASSET a ON i.ASSET_ID = a.ID WHERE a.ASSET_MODE IN (42, 201, 183, 318) AND a.ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND (i.STATUS = 1 OR (i.STATUS = 2 AND i.ALARM_STATE = 1)) and i.BLANK = 1 GROUP BY a.ID) alarm on t.id = alarm.id
where t.ORG_ID = #{orgId} and t.SHOW_TOPO = 1 and (t.ASSET_MODE = #{mode1} or t.ASSET_MODE = #{mode2} or t.ASSET_MODE = 183 or t.ASSET_MODE = 318)
and IS_DEL = 1 order by CASE WHEN v.name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, v.name

SELECT alarm.alarmLevel, v.node_id FROM asset t left join TOPO_VERTEX v on t.id = v.asset_id and t.org_id = v.org_id and v.core_asset_id = #{assetId} and v.node_type = 'netWorkAsset_topo' left join (SELECT a.ID, MIN(i.ALARM_LEVEL) alarmLevel FROM ALARM_INFO i LEFT JOIN ASSET a ON i.ASSET_ID = a.ID WHERE i.STATUS = 1 OR (i.STATUS = 2 AND i.ALARM_STATE = 1) GROUP BY a.ID) alarm on t.id = alarm.id
where IS_DEL = 1 and v.is_port is null order by CASE WHEN v.name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, v.name

SELECT alarm.alarmLevel, v.node_id FROM asset t left join TOPO_VERTEX v on t.id = v.asset_id and t.org_id = v.org_id left join (SELECT a.ID, MIN(i.ALARM_LEVEL) alarmLevel FROM ALARM_INFO i LEFT JOIN ASSET a ON i.ASSET_ID = a.ID WHERE a.ASSET_MODE IN (42, 201)
AND a.ORG_ID in
#{orgId}
AND (i.STATUS = 1 OR (i.STATUS = 2 AND i.ALARM_STATE = 1)) GROUP BY a.ID) alarm on t.id = alarm.id
where
t.ORG_ID in
#{orgId}
and
t.SHOW_TOPO = 1 and (t.ASSET_MODE = 42 or t.ASSET_MODE = 201)
and t.IS_DEL = 1 and v.is_port is null and v.NODE_TYPE= #{nodeType} order by CASE WHEN v.name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, v.name

SELECT alarm.alarmLevel, v.*, t.name as assetName, t.id as assetId, t.org_id as assetOrgId, t.watch, t.asset_mode as assetMode, f.view_url FROM asset t left join TOPO_VERTEX v on t.id = v.asset_id and t.org_id = v.org_id and v.node_type = 'pc_topo' left join FILE_RELATE f on f.ITEM_ID = t.id left join (SELECT a.ID, MIN(i.ALARM_LEVEL) alarmLevel FROM ALARM_INFO i LEFT JOIN ASSET a ON i.ASSET_ID = a.ID WHERE i.BLANK = 1 AND a.ASSET_MODE = #{mode1} AND a.ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND (i.STATUS = 1 OR (i.STATUS = 2 AND i.ALARM_STATE = 1)) GROUP BY a.ID) alarm on t.id = alarm.id
where t.ORG_ID = #{orgId} and t.SHOW_TOPO = 1 and t.ASSET_MODE = #{mode1} and t.DESK = 1831 and v.NODE_TYPE = #{nodeType} and IS_DEL = 1 order by CASE WHEN v.name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, v.name

SELECT alarm.alarmLevel, v.*, t.name as assetName, t.id as assetId, t.org_id as assetOrgId, t.asset_image as assetImage, t.show_core as showCore, t.watch, asset_mode as assetMode FROM asset t join TOPO_VERTEX v on t.id = v.asset_id and t.org_id = v.org_id and v.node_type = 'netWorkAsset_topo' and v.core_asset_id = #{assetId} left join (SELECT a.ID, MIN(i.ALARM_LEVEL) alarmLevel FROM ALARM_INFO i LEFT JOIN ASSET a ON i.ASSET_ID = a.ID WHERE a.ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND (i.STATUS = 1 OR (i.STATUS = 2 AND i.ALARM_STATE = 1)) GROUP BY a.ID) alarm on t.id = alarm.id
where t.ORG_ID = #{orgId} and t.SHOW_TOPO = 1 and IS_DEL = 1 order by CASE WHEN v.name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, v.name

SELECT alarm.alarmLevel, v.*, t.name as assetName, t.id as assetId, t.org_id as assetOrgId, t.row_index as rowIndex, t.COLUMN_INDEX as columnIndex FROM (select distinct t.id, t.name, t.row_index, t.COLUMN_INDEX, a.org_id from cabinet t, room a where a.id = t.room_id and a.org_id = #{orgId}) t left join TOPO_VERTEX v on v.asset_id = t.id and v.org_id = t.org_id left join ( SELECT c.ID id, MIN(i.ALARM_LEVEL) alarmLevel FROM CABINET c LEFT JOIN ROOM r ON c.ROOM_ID = r.ID LEFT JOIN ASSET_ATTACH a ON a.CABINET_ID = c.ID LEFT JOIN ALARM_INFO i ON a.ASSET_ID = i.ASSET_ID WHERE (i.STATUS = 1 OR (i.STATUS = 2 AND i.ALARM_STATE = 1)) and i.BLANK = 1 AND r.ORG_ID = #{orgId} GROUP BY c.ID ) alarm on t.id = alarm.id where t.ORG_ID = #{orgId}

SELECT v.*, t.name as assetName, t.id as assetId, t.org_id as assetOrgId, row_index, column_index FROM (select distinct t.id, t.name, a.org_id, t.row_index, t.column_index from cabinet t, room a where a.id = t.room_id and a.org_id = #{orgId}) t left join TOPO_VERTEX v on v.asset_id = t.id and v.org_id = t.org_id where t.ORG_ID = #{orgId} order by row_index, column_index

SELECT v.*, t.name as assetName, t.id as assetId, t.org_id as assetOrgId, row_index, column_index FROM (select distinct c.id, c.name, r.id as org_id, c.row_index, c.column_index from cabinet c, room r where r.id = c.room_id and r.id = #{roomId}) t left join TOPO_VERTEX v on v.asset_id = t.id and v.org_id = t.org_id where t.ORG_ID = #{roomId} order by row_index, column_index

select p.asset_id, p.status, v.node_id from topo_asset_port p join topo_vertex v on p.asset_id = v.asset_id and p.port_index = v.port_index and v.node_type = 'netWorkAsset_topo' and v.core_asset_id = #{assetId} left join asset a on a.id = p.asset_id where v.is_port = 1 and a.is_del = 1

select p.asset_id, p.status, v.node_id from topo_asset_port p join topo_vertex v on p.asset_id = v.asset_id and p.port_index = v.port_index and v.node_type = 'netWorkAsset_topo' and v.core_asset_id = #{assetId} left join asset a on a.id = p.asset_id where v.is_port = 1 and a.is_del = 1 and p.STATUS = 2

select localAssetId, targetAssetName, targetAssetId, localPortIndex, targetPortIndex from (select c.asset_id localAssetId, a.name targetAssetName, a.id targetAssetId, port_index_name localPortIndex, at_port_index_name targetPortIndex from asset a, collect_route c where a.id = c.at_asset_id and c.asset_id = #{assetId} and a.asset_mode in (201, 42)) group by localAssetId, targetAssetName, targetAssetId, localPortIndex, targetPortIndex

select c.asset_id localAssetId, a.name targetAssetName, a.id targetAssetId, port_index_name localPortIndex, at_port_index_name targetPortIndex from asset a, collect_route c where a.id = c.at_asset_id and c.asset_id = #{assetId}

select c.asset_id localAssetId, a.name targetAssetName, a.id targetAssetId, port_index_name localPortIndex, at_port_index_name targetPortIndex from asset a, collect_route c where a.id = c.asset_id and a.id = #{localId} and c.at_asset_id = #{targetId}

select asset_id, port_index, maOrAt, maAssetId, maPort from ( select v.asset_id, v.port_index, '1' as maOrAt, vv.asset_id maAssetId, vv.port_index maPort from topo_vertex v left join topo_edge e on v.node_id = e.edge_source left join topo_vertex vv on vv.node_id = e.edge_target where v.asset_id != vv.asset_id and v.port_index is not null and v.node_type = 'net_topo') where maPort is not null group by asset_id, port_index, maOrAt, maAssetId, maPort

SELECT alarm.alarmLevel, c.CABINET_ID, cc.ROW_INDEX as roww, cc.COLUMN_INDEX as col, v.*, t.name as assetName, t.id as assetId, t.org_id as assetOrgId, t.asset_image as assetImage, t.show_core as showCore, t.watch, t.A_B_FLAG, t.asset_mode as assetMode, f.VIEW_URL FROM asset t left join ASSET_ATTACH c on t.id = c.ASSET_ID left join CABINET cc on c.CABINET_ID = cc.id left join FILE_RELATE f on f.ITEM_ID = t.id left join TOPO_VERTEX v on t.id = v.asset_id and t.org_id = v.org_id AND v.node_type = 'all_topo' left join (SELECT a.ID, MIN(i.ALARM_LEVEL) alarmLevel FROM ALARM_INFO i LEFT JOIN ASSET a ON i.ASSET_ID = a.ID WHERE a.ASSET_MODE IN (42, 201, 183) AND a.ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND (i.STATUS = 1 OR (i.STATUS = 2 AND i.ALARM_STATE = 1)) and i.BLANK = 1 GROUP BY a.ID) alarm on t.id = alarm.id
where t.ORG_ID = #{orgId} and t.SHOW_TOPO = 1 and IS_DEL = 1 order by col, roww, v.name

SELECT v.*, o.title as assetName, o.id as assetId, 'line' as assetMode FROM sys_org o left join TOPO_VERTEX v on o.id = v.asset_id AND v.node_type ='all_topo' where o.type=3 and o.PID = #{orgId} order by v.name

SELECT c.CABINET_ID, cc.ROW_INDEX as roww, cc.COLUMN_INDEX as col, v.*, t.name as assetName, t.id as assetId, t.org_id as assetOrgId, t.asset_image as assetImage, t.show_core as showCore, t.watch, t.A_B_FLAG, t.asset_mode as assetMode FROM asset t left join ASSET_ATTACH c on t.id = c.ASSET_ID left join CABINET cc on c.CABINET_ID = cc.id left join TOPO_VERTEX v on t.id = v.asset_id and t.org_id = v.org_id AND v.node_type ='all_topo'
where t.ORG_ID = #{orgId} and t.SHOW_TOPO = 1 and IS_DEL = 1 order by col,roww ,v.name

SELECT v.*, o.title as assetName, o.id as assetId, 'line' as assetMode FROM sys_org o left join TOPO_VERTEX v on o.id = v.asset_id AND v.node_type ='all_topo' where o.type=3 and o.PID = #{orgId} order by v.name

SELECT V.*, t.show_core as showCore, T.NAME AS assetName, T.ID AS assetId, T.ORG_ID AS assetOrgId, ASSET_MODE AS assetMode FROM ASSET T LEFT JOIN TOPO_VERTEX V ON T.ID = V.ASSET_ID AND #{reqID} = V.ORG_ID WHERE T.ORG_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM SYS_ORG WHERE PID = #{reqID}) AND T.ASSET_MODE = 42 AND T.SHOW_TOPO = 1 AND T.IS_DEL = 1

SELECT V.*, t.show_core as showCore, T.NAME AS assetName, T.ID AS assetId, T.ORG_ID AS assetOrgId, ASSET_MODE AS assetMode FROM ASSET T LEFT JOIN TOPO_VERTEX V ON T.ID = V.ASSET_ID AND #{reqID} = V.ORG_ID WHERE T.ORG_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM SYS_ORG WHERE PID = #{reqID}) AND T.ASSET_MODE = 201 AND T.SHOW_TOPO = 1 AND T.IS_DEL = 1

SELECT V.*, t.show_core as showCore, T.NAME AS assetName, T.ID AS assetId, T.ORG_ID AS assetOrgId, ASSET_MODE AS assetMode FROM ( SELECT * FROM ASSET WHERE ORG_ID = (SELECT PID FROM SYS_ORG WHERE ID = #{reqID}) AND ASSET_MODE IN (42,201) AND SHOW_CORE = 'SHOW_TOPO_@_SHOW' AND SHOW_TOPO = 1 AND IS_DEL = 1 ) t LEFT JOIN TOPO_VERTEX V ON T.ID = V.ASSET_ID AND #{reqID} = V.ORG_ID ORDER BY V.NAME

select a.aLevel AS alarmLevel, v.*, t.name as assetName, t.id as assetId, t.show_core as showCore, t.org_id as assetOrgId, t.asset_image as assetImage, t.watch, asset_mode as assetMode from topo_vertex v left join ( select asset.* from asset join sys_org on asset.org_id = sys_org.id where sys_org.type = 4 ) t on t.id = v.asset_id left join ( select asset_id, MIN(alarm_level) as aLevel from alarm_info where BLANK = 1 and (STATUS = 1 OR ALARM_STATE = 1) group by asset_id ) a on a.asset_id = t.id where v.org_id = #{reqID} and t.asset_mode = 42 and t.show_topo = 1 and t.is_del = 1 order by v.name

select a.aLevel AS alarmLevel, v.*, t.name as assetName, t.id as assetId, t.show_core as showCore, t.org_id as assetOrgId, t.asset_image as assetImage, t.watch, asset_mode as assetMode from topo_vertex v left join ( select asset.* from asset join sys_org on asset.org_id = sys_org.id where sys_org.type = 4 ) t on t.id = v.asset_id left join ( select asset_id, MIN(alarm_level) as aLevel from alarm_info where BLANK = 1 and (STATUS = 1 OR ALARM_STATE = 1) group by asset_id ) a on a.asset_id = t.id where v.org_id = #{reqID} and t.asset_mode = 201 and t.show_topo = 1 and t.is_del = 1 order by v.name

select a.aLevel AS alarmLevel, v.*, t.name as assetName, t.id as assetId, t.show_core as showCore, t.org_id as assetOrgId, t.asset_image as assetImage, t.watch, asset_mode as assetMode from topo_vertex v left join ( select asset.* from asset join sys_org on asset.org_id = sys_org.id where sys_org.type = 2 ) t on t.id = v.asset_id left join ( select asset_id, MIN(alarm_level) as aLevel from alarm_info where BLANK = 1 and (STATUS = 1 OR ALARM_STATE = 1) group by asset_id ) a on a.asset_id = t.id where v.org_id = #{reqID} and t.asset_mode in (42,201) and t.show_topo = 1 and t.is_del = 1 order by v.name

select v.asset_id as assetId, v.node_id as nodeId, a.status as status from topo_vertex v left join topo_asset_port a on v.asset_id = a.asset_id and v.port_index = a.port_index where v.org_id = #{orgId} and v.node_type = #{nodeType} and a.status = 2 and v.is_port = 1

SELECT t.*, v.* FROM ( select r.id as roomId, r.name roomName, c.id as cabinetId, c.name as cabinetName, c.row_index, c.column_index from cabinet c right join room r on c.room_id = r.id where r.org_id = #{orgId} ) t left join topo_vertex v on v.asset_id = t.cabinetId order by row_index, column_index

SELECT a.cabinet_id, MIN(i.alarm_level) alarmLevel FROM asset_attach a LEFT JOIN alarm_info i ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id WHERE (i.status = 1 OR i.alarm_state = 1) AND i.blank = 1 AND i.alarm_level > 0 AND a.org_id = #{orgId} AND a.cabinet_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.cabinet_id

select r.id as roomId, r.name roomName, c.id as cabinetId, c.name as cabinetName, c.row_index as rowIndex, c.column_index as columnIndex from cabinet c right join room r on c.room_id = r.id where r.org_id = #{orgId} and c.id is not null

select a.id assetId, a.name assetName, a.ip assetIp, a.org_id orgId, a.service_type_id, b.alarm_status, b.host_type from asset a left join broker_topo_business b on a.id = b.asset_id where a.service_type_id is not null and a.org_id = #{orgId} and a.service_type_id = #{serviceTypeId}
